scope: exactly one no-model unauthenticated hook discovery using pinned Codex Windows executable in a separately approved egress-disabled Windows Sandbox guest
direct_workstation_blocker: pinned app-server constructs auth/cloud loaders and spawns online catalog worker before any request; no verified per-process network fence on the direct workstation
namespace_rule: Astra allocates a physical new directory atomically, validates its resolved ancestry, binds the complete directory and WSB bytes and consumes the run upon the first guest startup. Refuse a previously used path, alias or collision.
environment: Create a guest-only child environment with Windows system necessities, CODEX_HOME and dedicated guest TEMP/TMP. No inherited host account variables, auth files, secrets, browser data, proxies, external integrations or host settings.
effects: Create a single fresh guest, one fresh home and one fresh work root, copy the exact inert profile into the home.
Launch one pinned Codex process on stdio, make the frozen discovery exchange, close input, reconcile the owned process tree, and dispose the guest.
Retain only capped private transcripts, file hashes, scoped exit and cleanup evidence. No public transmission by the discovery operation.
refuse_if: Network fence unverified, target host/guest designation differs, or supplier/staged files/command/config differ
Any pre-existing state, settings, credentials, extra hooks/requests or stale/used identity
Unexpected trust state or errors, foreign/malformed frames, output bound, timeout, process uncertainty or cleanup mismatch
repeat: No replay after uncertain or observed startup under this identity. Read and retain bounded outcome first. A later distinct attempt needs a fresh approved scope.
success: A complete bounded same-process discovery preserving the exact request identity and native hooks/list result, with absent hook or exact untrusted hook, matching post-state and independently verified clean exit. No Y06, trust, entitlement, Stop or model credit.
network_ceiling: The guest option requires OS-enforced no external connectivity. It does not supply an assertion that the binary never made an internal network syscall.
standalone_reader_ceiling: The reader validates supplied ordered captured bytes only. Sol-DG18 independently checks original process ownership, configuration, received native bytes, guest network fence, closure and no credential/profile effects.
receiver_scope: Guest-only discovery. Requires Root decision that guest scope is useful and exact physical/verifiable preflight within the owner grant. Does not clear trust or readiness for the actual workstation.
forbidden: real profile or host firewall changes
launch_allowance: Exactly one observed or uncertain startup consumes launch permission. Bounded cleanup of the owned process remains in the same scope.
